title: Remove checkups feature

requirements.text: Remove all checkup-related UI elements from the Home dashboard page (frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx), including any tiles, sections, or references to checkups
acceptanceCriteria: The Home dashboard no longer displays checkup-related tiles or sections
All checkup navigation elements are removed
The dashboard layout remains functional after removal

requirements.text: Remove checkup-related backend endpoints, data types, and state from the main actor (backend/main.mo) if any exist
acceptanceCriteria: All checkup-related types are removed from the backend
All checkup-related query and update functions are removed
No orphaned state variables or data structures remain

requirements.text: Remove any checkup-related routes, pages, or components from the frontend application
acceptanceCriteria: All checkup-related routes are removed from the router configuration
All checkup page components are deleted

requirements.text: Remove checkup-related references from the assistant brain command interpreter (frontend/src/components/assistant/assistantBrain.ts) if any exist
acceptanceCriteria: Assistant no longer recognizes or responds to checkup-related commands
Medical knowledge base does not reference checkups

constraints: Preserve all other health dashboard features (heart rate, steps, hydration, calories)
Maintain existing navigation structure for remaining features
Do not modify authentication or profile management functionality
nonGoals: Adding new features to replace checkups
